product.name: Carpenter Baggy Jeans
product.description: Jeans in rigid cotton denim. Baggy fit from seat to hem with plenty of room around legs. Regular waist, zip fly with button, and dropped gusset. Patch front pockets, open back pockets, one leg with a two-part patch pocket, and one leg with a hammer loop. Rounded legs, stacked at ankle. It's denim perfection.

materialDetails.name: Recycled cotton
materialDetails.description: Recycled cotton is cotton made from textile waste in production or from end-of-life textile waste. The waste is mechanically recycled and spun into new yarn.
